question: Can the exact J6O one-geometry second public record be generated through a first-record-aware, action-bound causal adapter without exposing physical-error support or changing the frozen five-round phenomenological caller?
epistemic_role: Fixed-path public adapter and interface integrity gate only; not a general D4 conditional instrument or production-history promotion
source_basis: J6O source/operator-derived exact 24-site sequential joint public law on one ideal L=2 path
Lab 005 J6I audit: existing general post-flux sampler lacks a first-public-record input, while the old integrated caller is an action-bound phenomenological path

interface.input: trial ID, decision round 0, validated full-binary first public record and its causal-prefix digest, correction-edge action and its first-record-bound digest, independent second exogenous bit 0/1
interface.output: public completion with first/action binding digests and full-binary second public record or null on defer; no physical support, hidden projector state, parity relation or coin field
interface.law: lookup only exact J6O public-law rows after validating first record and action; coin 0/1 exhausts the two equal conditional second outcomes, with defer independent of the coin
interface.frozen_old_path: d4_integrated_history.py and the five-round caller are not modified or invoked

matrix.valid_cases: 2 first green outcomes x 3 actions x 2 second exogenous bits = 12 deterministic calls
matrix.independent_unit: one deterministic exact fixed-path law and enumerated exogenous bit; no sampled histories

acceptance: Both pinned hashes match. All 12 valid calls pass through the public adapter, preserve the exact J6O first record and action, and produce each positive J6O second outcome once per two coins; defer produces no E2.

First-record and action digests bind the same trial, round, first public arrays and correction edges. Tampered/swapped first or action, unsupported correction, malformed array, invalid coin and future/private field injection fail closed.

Public completion exposes only the stipulated trial/round, causal first/action digests, action edges, second full-binary arrays or null, and completion digest; no physical error, hidden state, parity-relation metadata or exogenous coin leaks. Repeated calls replay exactly.

The old integrated-history source is byte-identical and no stochastic histories, schedule arms, bootstrap replicates, risk contrasts or thresholds are created. A pass licenses only further general-geometry operator/kernel work, not five-round physical schedule sampling.
stop_rule: Fail closed on provenance drift, missing first-record input, invalid action/record acceptance, unequal conditional enumeration, any private/future leakage or frozen-caller modification. Do not silently route the fixed-path lookup into the general phenomenological five-round generator.
